## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl.kt

## Trigger

Starting a race, in startClock — observed

## Today

`RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl` keys every race it opens by an in-memory
identifier drawn from `nextId`, an `AtomicLong(1)` field on the
repository instance:

    private val nextId = AtomicLong(1)
    ...
    val race = Race(id = nextId.getAndIncrement(), ...)

That id is the race's `Race.id`. `RecordedRaceSyncService` sends it
unchanged as `RecordedRacePayload.raceId` (`raceId = race.id`,
core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/sync/RecordedRaceSyncService.kt).
On the phone, `RaceRepositoryImpl.saveRecordedRace` treats that number
as the sole key for detecting a resend:

    raceDao.findBySourceRaceId(raceId)?.let { existing ->
        return Result.success(toDomain(existing))
    }

There is no window (a date range, a session marker) and no other
uniqueness check behind that lookup — `sourceRaceId` alone decides.
Because `nextId` lives only in the repository instance, it resets to 1
every time the watch process restarts (an app relaunch, a device
reboot, the process killed and respawned by the OS). A race recorded
after such a restart can be assigned the same id as a race recorded,
synced and stored in an earlier process. When that happens,
`saveRecordedRace` matches it against the old row and returns the
stored race unchanged: the new race is never persisted and is lost.

## Expected

A race recorded by the watch carries an identifier that survives the
process that made it, so a genuinely new race can never collide with
one synced in an earlier session. The value `RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl`
assigns at `startClock` — and that flows unchanged into
`RecordedRacePayload.raceId` and into `saveRecordedRace`'s dedup
lookup — must not be reset to 1 on every process start. `saveRecordedRace`
keeps using that identifier as its sole dedup key; what changes is how
the watch produces it, not how the phone consumes it.
